async def act(page):
    # Find the complementary (sidebar) region and click the "July 2025" archive link
    comp = page.get_by_role("complementary")
    comp_count = await comp.count()
    if comp_count == 0:
        raise Exception("No complementary region found on the page")

    # Locate the archive link by exact visible name within the complementary region
    archive_link = comp.get_by_role("link", name="July 2025", exact=True)
    # Wait for it to be available and click it. This click is expected to navigate away,
    # so we make it the last action.
    await archive_link.wait_for(state="visible")
    await archive_link.click()
